title: Tell editors if they're short on battery when they start writing a new article.
body:
Thought this might be a nice simple feature. Just to have some sort of dialog that says 'You've only got 2 minutes battery life left, grab your charger before getting started' or something like that. 

Uses the Battery API in most modern browsers 
https://davidwalsh.name/battery-api
author: Participant 1

comments.author: Participant 3
comments.body:
This API got removed in Firefox, and in WebKit (Safari). Right now [only Chrome supports it](https://caniuse.com/#feat=battery-status) which probably isn't enough to justify the effort, so I'll close this.

NB: it got removed because there were concerns of breach of privacy, the battery status being an easy way to fingerprint users.

To achieve a similar-ish outcome we could work towards having some auto-save feature, like suggested for #2199, #995.
